No QR, no camera. Just make sure remote control is enabled in the game.
Couldn\'t find BeamNG.drive. In the game enable Options → Controls → Hardware → “Use your phone or tablet”, and keep the phone on the same Wi-Fi.
Easiest is Auto-Connect — no code needed. Otherwise take a clear photo of the game\'s QR and read it here, or paste the link / type the 5-digit code if you already have it.
No QR found in that photo — take a closer, sharper shot of just the QR.
This page shows YOUR real values. Type them into the game exactly as written — no guessing, no copying from screenshots.
— connect the phone to Wi-Fi and this page will fill it in —
Turn your phone into the steering wheel, gas and brake for the car in the game.
Connect your phone to the SAME Wi-Fi as your PC — the same home network / router. This is the one thing that must be right.
On your PC in BeamNG.drive: open Options → Controls → Hardware, find “Use your phone or tablet” and set it to Yes. A QR code appears — you can ignore it.
Come back to this app and tap the big AUTO-CONNECT button. Wait a few seconds — it finds the game by itself and connects. No QR, no typing.

Why Auto-Connect and not the QR: since v0.39 the game’s QR became too dense for most phone cameras to read. Auto-Connect skips the camera entirely and finds the game over your Wi-Fi, so it works on any phone.
Auto-Connect works for almost everyone. If it can’t find the game (a few Wi-Fi networks block it), try one of these:
Tap SCAN QR CODE and point your phone’s camera at the QR on your PC screen. Hold the phone steady and fairly close — it connects on its own.
B · Read the QR from a photo
Take a clear, close photo of the QR on your PC screen. Then tap CAN’T SCAN? ENTER CODE → READ QR FROM A PHOTO and choose that photo. The app reads it and connects.

Only if you already have the code. Where to find it: point ANY QR app — your normal phone camera or Google Lens — at the game’s QR. It opens a Google Play link that ends with “#12345”. Those last 5 digits ARE your code. Type them under CAN’T SCAN? ENTER CODE.
Unlocks on the drive screen: live speed, RPM needle, gear, fuel, engine temperature, turbo boost, real warning lights (signals, high beam, handbrake, ABS, TC, oil, battery) and crash vibration.
In game: Options → Other → scroll to Protocols
Tick “OutGauge support” and fill in the values below
Reload the vehicle once (Ctrl+R) — the game reads this when the car spawns
Shows a live drift angle above the speedometer while you slide, plus your session record. Great with the 0-100 timer (enable it in the app\'s Settings).
In game: Options → Other → Protocols (same place)
Tick “MotionSim enabled” and fill in the values below
Nothing arrives? Allow BeamNG.drive through the Windows Firewall.
Guest/hotel Wi-Fi often blocks phones from talking to PCs — use your own network or the phone\'s hotspot.
Router gave the phone a new IP? Re-check this page and update the game, then Ctrl+R.
Gauges frozen after a game update? Re-tick the options — settings occasionally reset.
